title: First BASIC#-Authored Compiler Component
purpose: Prove that a bounded compiler-domain decision component can be authored in BASIC#, compiled by the accepted independent compiler driver into real BSBC, loaded without its source, and executed by the independent BSharp VM while Ruby remains bootstrap referee.
required_proofs: the compiler-domain decision source is BASIC# source, not Ruby source
SmallCompilerSubsetDriver compiles the component through the independent pipeline
the checked-in BSBC artifact exactly matches independently compiled bytes
the artifact remains executable after the compiled source copy is deleted
the independent BSharp VM classifies every accepted compiler block head deterministically
repeated compilation produces byte-identical BSBC and readable disassembly
production compiler constructors are unnecessary on the primary native-component path
separate production BytecodeEmitter and BSharp VM referees match the native artifact exactly
separate Ruby Runtime referee semantics match every native decision
Profiles 1 through 7 and creator-facing syntax remain unchanged
